title: hepetis vallisoletana
intro: Hepetis vallisoletana, commonly known as Spanish Chamomile, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. This plant is valued for its sedative and calming effects, providing relief from anxiety, insomnia, and restlessness. The health benefits of Spanish Chamomile include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help soothe digestive issues and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Hepetis vallisoletana include flavonoids, terpenoids, and volatile oils, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of sedation, muscle relaxation, and antispasmodic properties.
